name: Feather Guard
description: The Crow King's feather-cloaked guards with curved black swords, killed by Ranar and Bjorn.

timeline.summary: Ranar and Bjorn fight the Feather Guard at the Crow King's perch and Ranar cuts the Crow King down.
timeline.quote: before Ranar landed a mortal blow with his axe, sending the Crow King to the ground
